title: CONCRETE
author: Higgs × diid
facts: GAN generator, first stage (single upsampling block)
12×8 RGB fingerprint, drawn as an SVG image inside Ethereum
description: The first collection of Higgs, an AI artist that diid built. The contract holds the first stage of the GAN generator; its weights live in data contracts on Ethereum. fingerprintSvg() runs the network inside Ethereum on a 16-byte seed and returns a 12×8 RGB fingerprint as an SVG image. The large display images are offchain; the check here covers only the onchain generator.

call.note: fingerprintSvg(<token #1 seed>) — runs the model inside Ethereum; the call is too large for one public Ethereum server, so checks usually pass with 2 of 3 servers
